title: Formalwear Wear Frequency and Storage Drag
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outfit:wear formal=yes
| stats count as wears, max(_time) as last_worn by item_name
| eval days_since_worn=round((now()-last_worn)/86400,0)
| sort - days_since_worn
description: Finds formalwear pieces that take up closet space despite going unworn for long stretches.
value: Special-occasion clothes are expensive and bulky; knowing what truly earns its keep helps with storage and resale decisions.
implementation: Mark formalwear in outfit logs and calculate days since each item's last wear.
visualization: Table of formalwear items by days since last wear.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which dressy pieces are just sitting in the closet taking up space.
